deals.comment: NAVER LABS Corp. agreed to acquire Xerox Research Centre Europe from Xerox Corporation (NYSE:XRX) on June 26, 2017. After closing of the transaction, all 80 researchers and administrative staff are expected to become part of NAVER Labs. Xerox Corporation will maintain ownership of intellectual property and arrange licensing agreements with NAVER Labs. The transaction is subject to fulfillment of certain customary conditions and is expected to close in third quarter of 2017. Xavier Doumen, Marion Salus, Alexandre Jeannerot, Alexandra Tuil, Marion Bélery, Corinne Knopp, Ghrislaine Oucharif, Mélody Pages, Bruno Knadjian, Pierre Denizot-Heller, Cullen G. Taylor and Jacqueline Lee of Hogan Lovells acted as legal advisors for NAVER Labs. Guillaume Nathan of Bryan Garnier & Co acted as financial advisor and Catherine Olive, Sophie Jouniaux and Lise Breteau of Osborne Clarke acted as legal advisors for Xerox Corporation.

LINE Plus Corporation agreed to acquire NemusTech Co., Ltd. for KRW 9 billion on August 25, 2017. As per terms, 0.4 million shares will be acquired and consideration will be paid in cash. The transaction is subject to negotiations with the counterparty on the terms and conditions of the transaction (number of shares, amount, and date of acquisition); hence there may be changes in the details in the future. For the year ended December 31, 2016, NemusTech Co., Ltd. reported total assets of KRW 3.7 billion, net assets of KRW 3.2 billion, sales of KRW 5.5 billion and net loss of KRW 305 million. The Board of Directors of Naver Corporation resolved the deal on August 25, 2017. The deal is expected to close on October 16, 2017.

Snow Corporation agreed to acquire Heart It Co., Ltd for KRW 2.1 billion on June 12, 2018. Under the terms, Snow Corporation will acquire 0.28 million shares of Heart It Co., Ltd. The consideration is paid in cash. Heart It Co., Ltd. (Korea) reported total assets of KRW 141 million, net assets of KRW 96 million, sales of KRW 540 million and net loss of current period of KRW 394 million as of December 31, 2017. The transaction has been resolved by the Board of Directors of Snow Corporation. The transaction is expected to be completed on June 21, 2018.

LINE Plus Corporation acquired additional 18.48% stake in GrayLab from Seungjin Lee and other shareholders for KRW 1 billion on June 12, 2020. Under the transaction, the LINE Plus purchased 2,490 shares for KRW 408,000 per share. As a result of the transaction the holding of LINE Plus will increase from 58.51% stake of GrayLab to 76.99% stake of GrayLab.

LINE Plus Corporation agreed to acquire additional 18.5% stake in GrayLab from Lee, Seung-jin and others for KRW 1 billion on June 14, 2021. In the acquisition, LINE Plus Corporation will acquire 611 shares from Lee, Seung-jin for KRW 249.3 million at a price of KRW 0.408 million per share.
